name: Elite Elementor Addons and Widgets
author: Webnobby Agency

sections.description:
Elite Elementor Addons is an all-in-one Elementor extension designed for users who need powerful design and WooCommerce features without extra plugins.

Build blogs, business websites, landing pages, eCommerce stores, and dynamic templates with 90+ free Elementor widgets, flexible Theme Builder, advanced Popup Builder, and dedicated WooCommerce Builder widgets.

The plugin is built for performance and workflow speed:
– Enable only the widgets you need (module toggle manager)
– Use global conditions to display templates and popups exactly where needed
– Create full WooCommerce experiences with product/archive/cart/checkout elements
– Use no-code controls and dynamic content support for scalable site building

Why Choose Elite Elementor Addons?

  • 90+ free Elementor widgets
  • Theme Builder with advanced display conditions
  • Popup Builder with behavioral triggers and scheduling
  • WooCommerce Builder widgets for product and shop pages
  • Mega Menu support and off-canvas navigation
  • Built-in integrations: Google Maps, Mailchimp, reCAPTCHA v3
  • WPML and Polylang-ready template workflow
  • Widget-level optimization controls for better frontend performance

Theme Builder (Advanced)

Build and assign custom templates for:
– Header
– Footer
– Archive
– Single
– Product Archive
– Product Single
– Saved Templates

Flexible display conditions include:
– Entire site
– Archive pages (author, date, search, category, tag)
– Custom post type archives
– Custom taxonomy archives
– Singular pages (post, page, CPT)
– Front page and 404 page
– WooCommerce product archive, category, tag, search, and single product

Popup Builder

Design fully custom popups in Elementor and target them with advanced triggers:

  • On page load (with delay)
  • On page scroll progress
  • On scroll to specific element
  • After specific date/time
  • After user inactivity
  • Exit intent
  • Custom trigger selector (button/link click)

Popup behavior options include:
– Show again delay (from minutes to days/month)
– Modal popup or top bar notification mode
– Responsive width, height, alignment, overlay, close button, and animation controls

Form & Marketing Features

Form widgets support practical actions and integrations:
– Send Email
– Mailchimp subscription
– Webhook action
– File upload
– Form submissions handling
– reCAPTCHA v3

SEO & Performance Notes

Elite Elementor Addons helps you build search-friendly pages with structured content blocks, dynamic archive layouts, fast navigation components, and modular widget loading.

Use these built-in controls for better performance and crawlability:
– Disable unused widgets/extensions
– Build optimized archive/single templates for content silos
– Use Ajax search and mega menu for better content discovery
– Keep UX clean with targeted popup display conditions
sections.installation:
This plugin requires Elementor.

  1. Install through the WordPress plugins screen, or upload files to /wp-content/plugins/elite-elementor-addons.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page.
  3. Open Elite Elements from WP Admin to manage widgets, extensions, and settings.
  4. In Elementor editor, find widgets under the Elite Elementor Addons category.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin without Elementor?

No. Elite Elementor Addons is an extension for Elementor.

Does it work with Elementor Pro?

Yes. It works with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with themes compatible with Elementor.

Will it affect website speed?

The plugin includes module toggles so you can disable unused widgets and extensions to reduce frontend load.

Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce is only required for WooCommerce Builder widgets and eCommerce-specific features.

I need help or support. How can I contact you?

Contact us here: Support Form

Recommended PHP settings

  • PHP: 5.6+
  • memory_limit: 256M or higher
  • max_execution_time: 300
  • post_max_size: 64M+
